note.item: 5.x summary: one package: pkg_cbmodulecontent contains the CB list module, the {cbprofile} content plugin and their shared library, all with one version number. It upgrades an existing module or plugin in place, and updates come from the package update server
5.x summary: Joomla 5 and 6 native: namespaces, service providers and events, so the Backward Compatibility plugin is no longer needed. Requires Joomla 5.0 and PHP 8.1

5.x summary: security hardening: HTML in profile fields is shown as text, [tags] and {plugin tags} in user data are no longer run, the debug query is only shown to Super Users and {cbprofile} tag values are checked and escaped
5.x summary: many CB list filter errors fixed: contains, IN, Is not one of, Is empty / Is not empty, an apostrophe in a value and lists without user groups

fix.item: avatars of the content plugin are shown at imagewidth and imageheight, also when the template sets max-width or height auto on images (the padding no longer makes them 10px smaller, a non-square image is cropped instead of stretched)

addition.item: English and Dutch translations of the module, the plugin, the library and the package
the module has layouts (tmpl), also as override in the template

change.item: module, plugin and library use the structure of Joomla 5 and 6 (namespaces, service providers, events) and no longer need the Backward Compatibility plugin
the library has classes (Tazzios\Library\CbListHelper) instead of global functions
fewer database queries in the module
the package checks for Joomla 5.0 and PHP 8.1 and removes the files of older versions
